people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Uriah
people.line: Prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem

translations.web: There was also a man who prophesied in Yahweh’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
translations.bsb: Now there was another man prophesying in the name of the LORD, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim. He prophesied against this city and against this land the same things that Jeremiah did.
translations.kjv: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
